columns.description: Explicit schema of every staged column

dataset.description: Full-table handle when observations exceed inline budget; null otherwise

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unsupported_parameter`: Selected parameter is unavailable for this community and resolution. `unsupported_preset`: Preset is unavailable at this resolution. `invalid_window`: Window is reversed, impossible or outside source coverage. `invalid_correction`: Wind settings are unpaired or correction inputs are missing. `upstream_rejected`: NASA rejects the scientific request. `upstream_rate_limited`: NASA responds with a rate limit. `request_queue_full`: Source scheduling capacity is exhausted. `dataset_limit`: Complete data exceeds a bounded workload limit. `producer_capacity_exhausted`: Other data calls hold the in-flight capacity this call needs past its admission wait. `canvas_capacity_exhausted`: Canvas count, table or retained staging capacity is exhausted. `canvas_busy`: Another query, staging or removal occupies the supplied canvas. `canvas_required`: Oversized observations require an enabled workspace. `canvas_not_found`: The supplied workspace token is absent or expired. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.
